_comment: Byte ceiling per contract wasm, checked by scripts/check-wasm-sizes.sh after `stellar contract build`. Each was set at the size on 2026-10-30 plus about 20%, rounded up. Raise a budget deliberately, in the commit that needs the room, so growth is argued for rather than absorbed. coverage_ledger raised to 26000 (21656 bytes + 20%) for sign_coverage (#144). covered_vault raised to 10350 (8609 bytes + 20%) for simulate_coverage and CoverageLedgerInterface::get_supply (#142). reporter_registry raised to 7500 on 2026-11-21 (6230 bytes + 20%) for time-locked upgrades (#30). The upgrade_fixture_* budgets equal their real contract's, since each fixture compiles that contract's lib.rs and is the same size (#30).
